description: Ministry of Labour and Foreign Employment - Industrial Disputes between  National Saving Bank Colombo 03 and other part Ceylon Bank employees Union Colombo 10 (E Only)
categorisation: This gazette content publishes a collective agreement between a bank and a union under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains legal/regulatory content including statutory publication requirements, contractual terms, employment conditions, and regulatory compliance matters. The document represents a legally binding agreement published in accordance with statutory authority, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than government personnel/structure or other specialized categories.
